title: Edit
text: Enter new value for parameter, {Align} sets Text alignment; {Connection} sets the block parameter value to connect parameter value connection, {Label} sets the block label position, {Opacity} sets the block background opacity, {Foreground Color} sets the block foreground color and {Background Color} sets the block background color. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Block parameter value to connect parameter value connection options

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label position Hide (default) | Bottom | Top

params.name: Foreground Color
params.values: Block foreground color [r g b] vector

params.name: Background Color
params.values: Block background color [r g b] vector
